evidence: The ALD cycle was composed from the following steps:6 the substrates were first exposed for 2 s to the vapor of TiCl 4, then the reactor was purged for 2 s by the flow of pure nitrogen, exposed to the vapor of H 2O for 2 s and finally again purged in the flow of pure nitrogen for 5 s. This cycle was repeated 400–800 times to obtain 20–40 nm thick TiO 2 films.
